box.text:
leapplus1 = |leap| + 1 (samples)
step = 1 / leapplus1 (phase increment per sample)
phase wraps 0-1 every leapplus1 samples -- this IS the gate/timing ramp
out1=phasor  out2=step (1/leapplus1, used by Width cap)  out3=leapplus1 (debug)

width(eff) = min(width, leap)
Width can never exceed Leap -- caps it if the user drags it higher

scalar = (0.5 - amount/100) * 2, mapped here as scale(-100,200 -> 6,-6)
25%=+1 (no effect, matches original 0%)  75%=-1 (full inversion, matches original 100%)
30ms smoothing via pack+line~ to avoid zipper noise, then -1 for downstream use

t = scale(-100,200 -> -1,2): 0%=dry(t=0)  100%=original fold exactly(t=1)  beyond=amplify/overshoot
30ms smoothing, then blend weight = 1-2t (used to crossfade polarized vs folded signal)

multiplier = 1 + (gate*ampMinus1)  polarized = audio*multiplier
Skew (in7) applies asymmetric gain to polarized based on ITS OWN sign -- applied
BEFORE Asymmetry, so the two are fully independent (no interaction at zero-crossing)
sign(skewedPolarized) blended via Implosion t: final = skewedPolarized*(1-2t) + sign*t
At exactly skewedPolarized==0, sign uses Asymmetry instead of a fixed value (see in6)
clip(-1,1) safety limiter, always active
in: audio, gate, ampMinus1, 1-2t, t(smoothed), asymmetryValue, skewValue
out: clipped, skewedPolarized, signVal, final(pre-clip), liveGain
